Definition: from G4862 and G3004 in its original sense; to collect:--gather (together, up).
BiblicalUsage: In the parable of the wheat and the tares Jesus says to let both grow together until the harvest, when the reapers will gather the tares first and bind them to burn, and gather the wheat into His barn. The gathering is not ours to do early, and the end sorts what we cannot.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God will do the sorting at the harvest, so I leave judgment to Him and get on with growing where He planted me.
RelatedEvents: The Parable of the Wheat and the Weeds
